note: 骗局栏目为流量爆款，也是保护读者的重点。识别原则：凡是先让你垫付、交押金、交会费、买账号/'入场券'的，一律高度警惕。以下为套路拆解，非操作教程。

scams.title: 抖音挂机赚钱：手机放着就能赚钱？
scams.titleEn: Douyin Idle-Earning: Money While Your Phone Sits?
scams.summary: 宣称'手机上挂个软件，躺着刷播放量就能日进百元'，实际多为引流套路。
scams.summaryEn: Claims of easy money from idle apps are usually a funnel to something else.

steps.zh: 用短视频/群聊晒出'挂机收益截图'，吸引加群或下载 App
steps.en: Post fake earnings screenshots in videos or groups to pull people into chat groups or apps

steps.zh: 先让你免费试玩小额，作出'真能提现'的假象
steps.en: Let you try a small amount first to create the illusion of real withdrawals

steps.zh: 随后以'会员费/软件授权/升级套餐'为由要求先交钱
steps.en: Then ask for upfront payment framed as membership, license or upgrade fees

steps.zh: 交钱后以'任务异常/账户冻结'为由拖延提现，再诱导继续充值
steps.en: After payment, delay withdrawals citing account issues and push for more top-ups

steps.zh: 拉黑跑路或换个马甲重来
steps.en: Block you and reappear under a new identity

redFlags: 要求先交钱才能提现（会员费、授权费、解冻费）
收益截图金额整齐、话术夸张（夸大回报、轻松赚钱之类）
没有可核实的公司主体与合同，只靠私聊沟通
让你发展下线、拉人头升级
redFlagsEn: Upfront fees required before withdrawal (membership, license, unlock fees)
Neat, exaggerated earning screenshots and hype language
No verifiable company or contract — private chats only
Pressure to recruit downlines to level up
scams.verdict: 凡是承诺'零操作高收益'的挂机项目，基本可直接判定为骗局。正规平台不会有'交钱才能提现'这一环节。
scams.verdictEn: Any idle-earnings scheme promising high returns with no work is almost certainly a scam. Legit platforms never charge to withdraw.

scams.title: AI 代做 / 刷单：'AI 自动赚钱'的新包装
scams.summary: 把传统刷单换上'AI 代运营''智能接单'的外衣，本质是先垫付再拉黑。
scams.summaryEn: Old fake-order scams repackaged as AI automation — the core is upfront payment then disappearing.

steps.zh: 用'AI 全自动跑单''无人值守赚钱'等话术吸引关注
steps.en: Lure with claims of fully automated AI earnings

steps.zh: 展示伪造的后台数据，营造'稳定出单'假象
steps.en: Show fabricated dashboards to imply steady orders

steps.zh: 要求购买'AI 软件''脚本授权'或垫付刷单本金
steps.en: Ask you to buy AI software, script licenses or advance order capital

steps.zh: 前几单小额返还建立信任，诱导加大投入
steps.en: Return small amounts on the first orders to build trust, then push bigger sums

steps.zh: 大额投入后以'系统风控''流水不足'为由拒绝返还
steps.en: Refund large sums with excuses like risk control or insufficient turnover

redFlags: 刷单本身违法违规，任何让你'刷单返佣'的直接拉黑
要求垫付本金、多次转账到不同账户
所谓 AI 软件无法试用、无正规公司信息
承诺'回本周期''保本收益'
redFlagsEn: Fake ordering is illegal — block anyone asking you to do it for commission
Upfront capital and transfers to different accounts
AI software with no trial and no company details
Promises of guaranteed returns or payback periods
scams.verdict: 刷单返佣在中国属于违法行为，参与资金被骗也难以维权。'AI'只是营销词，不改变骗局本质。
scams.verdictEn: Commission-based fake ordering is illegal; victims have little legal recourse. 'AI' is just a marketing label.

scams.title: 垫付任务 / 交押金：最经典的副业骗局
scams.summary: 以'任务保证金''入职押金''代办费'名义先收钱，是最普遍、最容易识别的一类骗局。
scams.summaryEn: The most common scam: collect a deposit, 'onboarding fee' or agency fee before any real work.

steps.zh: 在招聘平台/社群发布'高薪兼职，日结'岗位
steps.en: Post high-paying part-time jobs with daily pay in job groups

steps.zh: 面试极简，快速'录用'，制造机会稀缺感
以押金、培训费、材料费、账号购买费等名目要求先转账
steps.en: Request transfers for deposits, training fees, materials or account purchases

steps.zh: 收钱后敷衍派单或失联
steps.en: Send token tasks or go silent after receiving money

redFlags: 任何'先交钱后上岗'的兼职——正规工作不收求职者钱
薪资明显高于市场、入职却零门槛
私人账户收款、拒绝签合同
催促“名额有限，先交先得”
redFlagsEn: Any job asking you to pay first — real employers don't charge candidates
Payment to personal accounts and refusal to sign contracts
Urgency tactics: limited slots, pay first
scams.verdict: 记住一条铁律：让你先掏钱的'赚钱机会'，无论包装成什么，都不要参与。
scams.verdictEn: One iron rule: never pay money for a money-making opportunity, no matter how it's packaged.
